controller.execution: One owned agent child under MAIN guard, all DS4 environment cleared then frozen policy/shader variables only. Preserve all first tool/output/error/cap/timeout outcomes; do not repair the conversation or retry a failed model attempt.
controller.save: Only if a separately reviewed private frontend calls the real save function at the completed third boundary. controller.timeout: Explicit whole-task deadline and birth-safe guard ownership/cleanup; no signal to a reaped old process group.
controller.contamination: If the model reads or prints updater/gold contents rather than invoking the prescribed updater, retain that first attempt and classify semantic evidence as contaminated; do not retry or use a later answer as an uncontaminated success.
controller.structural_failure: If the fixed third User is fewer than128 tokens, or none of the sixteen frozen candidates is eligible, stop with a retained eligibility failure before third-turn evaluation; no adaptive notes, tape expansion, conversation repair or retries.
controller.frozen_project_inputs: Updater logic, selected-edit data schema, immutable external grader and controller implementation require a separate source freeze and review before any actual task grant. This file freezes task text, gold and structural selection policy only.

success_components.structural: Actual pair reuse trace has odd source-destination displacement, positive reused span, complete tape, repaired pairs, latest_user_fresh1, fresh>=128 and unique admission<=160MiB. Exact fallback is safe but does not count as reuse success.
success_components.semantic: Original code control passes and the first completed edited task passes all immutable gold checks with current3141/CODE formatting. Report wrong/capped/timeout/invalid results separately.
success_components.hidden_state: Native caller controls and separate raw-vector/state diagnostics assess reconstruction. limitations: One simple preregistered compaction/reuse task. No independent task generalization, latency/default promotion, privacy/forgetting, quantization causality or full hidden-state reconstruction claim. No production or runtime source edits are implied.
